value.message: Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre has Parent and Tot for 18 months to 3.11 yrs, Saturdays 9:00-9:30 and other slots, Sept 12 to Dec 18 - their site says, though I could not get into the page today to pin down the price. The Town of Halton Hills also has Parent and Tot swim, Oct 3 to Dec 7, $86.22 for 9 lessons at Acton - their site says. I'll keep watching and text you when I have more.
